title: Three Months and One Short Notice
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：region　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 region 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the warden ① governed the region that no resident in the centre would have noted, and he said the governing was the whole of the month. The ② region, meaning the area itself and not the notice, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; a region, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ region in that centre had the same short notice beside it, and the ④ region at the far gate, meaning the form they kept for the children to fill in and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A region, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the warden said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the region was the whole of the matter, meaning the identity and not the area. The ⑥ region, meaning the identity and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; region, he said, is either something you govern or the only word that means both an area and an identity. He said the identity is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ region had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short notice. The ⑧ region of the whole thing, the warden wrote in June, was one centre and three months of noting; region, he said, is either the form at the far gate or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ region I remember is the area noted in the register, which closed in 1963 and is still noted as the quietest in the centre. A ⑩ region, my mother said in 1965, is the only area that improves by being noted; every region, she said, is an identity that has agreed to look like an area. She said the identity was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 地区；区域（指社区中心里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 地区；区域（指那个地区本身，与小小的告示相对）
C. 固定搭配：govern the region 治理这一个地区
D. n. 地区；区域（指留给孩子们填的那一张）
E. n. 地区之事（抽象总称，指一处社区中心的地区之事）
F. n. 地区；区域（指登记册里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 地区、归属（指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 归属（抽象总称，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: governed the region that no resident in the centre would have noted
The region, meaning the area itself and not the notice
the region at the far gate
the region was the whole of the matter
the region had become a line in a register
The region of the whole thing
A region, my mother said in 1965

answers.why: govern the region 意为“治理这一个地区”，1956 年那位管理员把社区中心里没有一位居民肯记下的一个地区做了一遍。
region 意为“地区；区域”，指那个地区本身而不是小小的告示，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
region 意为“地区；区域”，指社区中心里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一张小小的告示。
region 意为“地区；区域”，指最远那道大门的留给孩子们填的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
region 意为“地区、归属”，指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个归属就是那件事的全部。
region 意为“归属”，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个地区，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
region 意为“地区；区域”，指登记册里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1961 年这一个成了登记册里的一行。
region 意为“地区之事”，管理员六月写道，整件事的地区之事是一处社区中心和三个月份的记下。
region 意为“地区；区域”，我记得的是登记册里记下过的那一个，1963 年办妥了，至今仍被说成社区中心里最安静的一个。
region 为抽象总称，母亲 1965 年说，地区是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的地区。
